title: inGitDB Collection Definition
description: Schema for a collection definition file, `.collection/definition.yaml` inside a collection directory (or `.collections/<name>/definition.yaml` in the shared layout). A subcollection uses the same format at `.collection/subcollections/<sub>/definition.yaml`. Unknown keys are rejected by inGitDB, so this schema does not allow additional properties.

id.description: Ignored: the collection id is taken from its directory name. Accepted because inGitDB accepts it.

inherits.description: Path of a partial base definition to overlay under this one, relative to the directory of this file. Columns merge by name (this definition wins); other fields fill in where this one leaves them unset.

titles.description: Localized titles for the collection, keyed by locale code (e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr').

data_dir.description: Optional relative path to the directory containing the collection's data files.

columns.description: A map of column IDs to their definitions. At least one column must be defined.

columns_order.description: An ordered list of column IDs defining the display order. Each entry must reference a column defined in 'columns'. Duplicates are not allowed.

primary_key.description: Column names composing the source primary key, in declared order. Written by importers; readers fall back to `$key` when empty.

source_schema.description: The relational schema of an imported collection (fields, indexes, foreign keys). Descriptive, not a write constraint. Written by importers.

default_view.description: The default view of the collection, declared inline.

min_records_count.description: The collection must hold at least this many records. For a subcollection it applies to each parent record's instance.

max_records_count.description: The collection may hold at most this many records. `0` means it must be empty. For a subcollection it applies to each parent record's instance.

cache_control.description: Optional HTTP Cache-Control directive string (RFC 9111) telling readers how long this collection's files may be cached. Overrides the database-level cache_control in .ingitdb/settings.yaml. A declared value may tighten the origin's header, and relax it only when the read is pinned to a commit SHA. Example: 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable'.

RecordFileDef.title: Record File Definition
RecordFileDef.description: Defines how records are stored in files — including the file naming pattern, serialization format, and whether the file contains a single record, a list, or a map.

name.description: File name pattern for record files. Supports placeholders: '{key}' is replaced with the record key, '{column_name}' is replaced with the value of that column.

format.description: The serialization format of the record file. Lowercase.

type.title: Record Type
type.description: Defines how records are stored within the file.

x-enum-descriptions.map[string]any: Single record per file — each record is stored as a key-value map in its own file.
x-enum-descriptions.[]map[string]any: List of records — multiple records stored as an ordered array in a single file. Required by the csv and jsonl formats.
x-enum-descriptions.map[$record_id]map[$field_name]any: Dictionary of records — multiple records stored in a single file as a map keyed by record id.

records_dir.description: Directory below the collection's data directory where record files live. `.` means the data directory itself. Defaults to `$records` when `name` contains `{key}`, else the data directory. Relative, forward slashes, must not go above the data directory.

exclude_regex.description: Regular expression matched against file names; matching files are not records (not read, validated or counted).

content_field.description: For the markdown format: the field that receives the Markdown body below the front matter.

csv_cell_encoding.description: Cell encoding for the csv format.

ColumnDef.title: Column Definition
ColumnDef.description: Defines the schema for a single column in a collection. The column named `$ID` describes the record key; when it is typed int, float, bool, date, time or datetime, every record key must parse as that type.

type.title: Column Type
type.description: The data type of the column: a scalar type, `map[locale]string`, a map type `map[keyType]valueType`, or a list type `[]elementType`.

anyOf.description: A map type with a supported key type. Format: 'map[keyType]valueType' where keyType is one of: locale, string, int, number, bool, date. The value type is not checked.
A list type. Every element must match the element type; `[]any` accepts any element but the value must be a list.

title.description: A display title for the column (single locale).

titles.description: Localized column titles, keyed by locale code.

valueTitle.description: A display title for the column's value.

required.description: Whether a value for this column is required. Defaults to false.

required_when.description: A Starlark expression over the record's stored sibling fields; the column is required when it evaluates to True. Cannot be combined with `required`.

length.description: Exact required length: characters for a string, elements for a list, entries for a map.

min_length.description: Minimum length: characters for a string, elements for a list, entries for a map.

max_length.description: Maximum length: characters for a string, elements for a list, entries for a map.

min_value.description: Inclusive lower bound for a numeric column.

max_value.description: Inclusive upper bound for a numeric column.

enum.description: The permitted values. Each member must be assignable to the column type.

foreign_key.description: The id of the root collection whose record keys this column's values must match (e.g. 'users' or 'auth.users'). A bare id is tried module-first: '<module of this collection>.<id>', then '<id>'. A list value is checked element by element.

locale.description: Pairs this column with the `map[locale]string` column named this column's name plus `s` (e.g. `title` with `titles`).

format.description: Free-form hint about the logical content (e.g. markdown, html, json, uri, email). Not validated.

formula.description: A Starlark expression that makes this a computed (virtual) column. Its value must not be stored.

ViewDef.title: View Definition
ViewDef.description: A view of the collection, as declared in a view file or inline as `default_view`.

ConflictResolution.description: Overrides the database-level conflict-resolution settings for this collection.

$comment: columns and record_file are required unless the definition inherits them (inherits).
